gaps: B070 nonzero imaginary/complex/polar, mode137 and mode-specific equation/inequality hooks, special status/error contexts remain partial; unsupported contexts return-1. Special37BC and BASE-N fixed-row branches are translated. Natural-input selection10 with8130 nonzero takes an untranslated cached viewport path and is explicitly rejected.

B070/37BC numeric scratch RAM remains untranslated because numeric/formatter APIs expose records and tokens rather than native operand workspaces:0x8006 and inactive0x8640 metric slots for natural output,0x8000..0x8009 for legacy/special text. Intermediate complex-component C060 state is outside the complete real C060/3634 adapter.
Selection 15 tagged rational/surd formatting remains a formatter gap; the controller propagates explicit formatting failure.
Special BASE-N rejects invalid nonempty base masks and raw glyph8127 mode; C060 error records and mode137 serialization are untranslated. Null-value title lookup retains all80FA byte values.
Viewport fallback with a failed second measurement or a nonterminating overlapping copy is an explicit pending native-state audit; tested fallback replacements succeed.
Cursor painting/blink scheduling is a separate UI routine; this subsystem translates cursor geometry and blink metadata.
Physical CPU-stack-space check 0x52D6: portable semantic API has no native CPU stack;  recursion/count limits are modeled.
Unsupported arbitrary font-state glyph rasterization reads original stack scratch beyond nine decoded rows; supported raster fonts 6, 7 and 10 are translated.
Original caller-stack corruption for certain small control glyph coordinates is preserved as explicit writes and recorded in parity-ledger.json; no CPU stack is emulated.
Malformed cyclic/nonterminating token scans are bounded in C. Successful finite-span cases are compared with the original; potential infinite native loops are not emulated.

Out-of-range display rows can alias the native call stack and loop counters: clear rows 33..130 and scroll rows 32..255 fail to return in the seeded oracle. Portable C applies bounded explicit memory arithmetic without reproducing native CPU-stack aliases; complete invalid-call memory parity is outside this semantic API.
